basic_details.job_title: DLSA Morigaon Para Legal Volunteer/ Adhikar Mitra Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Residents of Morigaon District can apply for engagement as Para Legal Volunteers (PLVs)/Adhikar Mitras for one year with the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Morigaon (Zila Ain Sewa Pradhikaran, Morigaon, Assam). The application form, in an envelope addressed to the District & Sessions Judge-cum-Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Morigaon, Assam, PIN-782105, must be dropped in the drop box at the DLSA office in the Judicial Court Premises, Morigaon, on or before 05:00 PM of 19 November 2026 (Thursday). No application fee is required.

important_dates.viva-voce: To be notified on the official website

qualification.details: Residence: applicants must be residents of Morigaon District. Nationality: the applicant must be a citizen of India. Educational qualification: minimum qualification of Matriculation (10th Pass). Attitude: applicants should have the mindset to work for the marginalised section of the society. Age: the minimum age should not be less than 21 years as on 01.01.2026. The notice prints no upper age limit. Preference: preferably, PLVs shall be selected who do not work up to the income they desire from their service as PLVs but have a mind-set to assist the needy in the society. Pay: the work of PLVs does not carry any salary, remuneration or wage, except an honorarium fixed by the District Legal Services Authority, Morigaon from time to time, as per Rules. | The notice lists these groups: | Teachers (including retired teachers) Retired Government Servants (Ex-servicemen) and Senior Citizens Master in Social Work (M.S.W) students and teachers Anganwadi Workers Doctors/Physicians Students and Law Students (till they enrol as lawyers) Members of Non-Political Service Oriented NGOs and Clubs Members of Women Neighbourhood Groups, Maithri Sanghrams and other Self-Help Groups, including marginalized and vulnerable groups Educated prisoners with good behaviour, serving long term sentences in prisons Persons from the tea tribe community residing in Tea Estates in the district Persons from a defence background or their family members Any other person whom the District Legal Services Authority deems fit to be identified as PLVs | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

Shortlisting: candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of documents relating to experience and qualification. The decision of the Chairman

DLSA Morigaon on the number of candidates shortlisted for interview is final. Publication: the names of shortlisted candidates will be published on the DLSA notice board and the official website of Morigaon District Judiciary
https://morigaon.dcourts.gov.in/. No individual call letters will be issued. Viva-voce: shortlisted candidates will appear in a viva-voce before the Selection Committee. The date

important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected without assigning any reason. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview. Canvassing, directly or indirectly, will disqualify the candidate. In case of any objection about the selection of PLVs, the decision of the Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Morigaon is final and binding on all concerned. For queries, the DLSA letterhead gives the email [email protected] and mobile number 6901281641.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Residence: applicants must be residents of Morigaon District. Nationality: the applicant must be a citizen of India. Educational qualification: minimum qualification of Matriculation (10th Pass). Attitude: applicants should have the mindset to work for the marginalised section of the society. Age: the minimum age should not be less than 21 years as on 01.01.2026. The notice prints no upper age limit. Preference: preferably, PLVs shall be selected who do not work up to the income they desire from their service as PLVs but have a mind-set to assist the needy in the society. Pay: the work of PLVs does not carry any salary, remuneration or wage, except an honorarium fixed by the District Legal Services Authority, Morigaon from time to time, as per Rules. The notice lists these groups: Teachers (including retired teachers) Retired Government Servants (Ex-servicemen) and Senior Citizens Master in Social Work (M.S.W) students and teachers Anganwadi Workers Doctors/Physicians Students and Law Students (till they enrol as lawyers) Members of Non-Political Service Oriented NGOs and Clubs Members of Women Neighbourhood Groups, Maithri Sanghrams and other Self-Help Groups, including marginalized and vulnerable groups Educated prisoners with good behaviour, serving long term sentences in prisons Persons from the tea tribe community residing in Tea Estates in the district Persons from a defence background or their family members Any other person whom the District Legal Services Authority deems fit to be identified as PLVs Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form Two (02) copies of recent passport size photographs Self-attested photocopies of all necessary testimonials in support of age Self-attested photocopies in support of qualification Computer diploma/certificate Driving licence, etc. The applicant must also write a mobile/contact number in the application for further communication.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is in two stages: shortlisting on documents, then a viva-voce. Shortlisting: candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of documents relating to experience and qualification. The decision of the Chairman, DLSA Morigaon on the number of candidates shortlisted for interview is final. Publication: the names of shortlisted candidates will be published on the DLSA notice board and the official website of Morigaon District Judiciary, https://morigaon.dcourts.gov.in/ . No individual call letters will be issued. Viva-voce: shortlisted candidates will appear in a viva-voce before the Selection Committee. The date, time and venue will be notified in due course only through the official website. Training: selected PLVs must undergo a training programme as decided by the District Legal Services Authority, Morigaon.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for DLSA Morigaon PLV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application must be dropped in the DLSA drop box on or before 05:00 PM of 19 November 2026 (Thursday).

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for Para Legal Volunteer in Morigaon?
faq.answer: Applicants need the minimum qualification of Matriculation (10th Pass) and should have the mindset to work for the marginalised section of society.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for DLSA Morigaon PLV?
faq.answer: The minimum age should not be less than 21 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a PLV/Adhikar Mitra in Morigaon?
faq.answer: The work carries no salary, remuneration or wage, only an honorarium fixed by the District Legal Services Authority, Morigaon from time to time, as per Rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No fee is required to apply for the Para Legal Volunteer (PLV)/Adhikar Mitra posts.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for DLSA Morigaon PLV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Put the filled application form with two photographs and self-attested documents in an envelope superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF PARA LEGAL VOLUNTEER (PLV)", addressed to the District & Sessions Judge-cum-Chairman, DLSA, Morigaon, Assam, PIN-782105, and drop it in the drop box at the Judicial Court Premises, Morigaon.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on documents relating to experience and qualification, and shortlisted candidates appear in a viva-voce before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the PLV engagement?
faq.answer: The period of engagement is 1 year, and selected PLVs must undergo a training programme decided by DLSA Morigaon.

faq.question: Q9. Will shortlisted candidates get a call letter?
faq.answer: No individual call letters will be issued; the shortlist is published on the notice board and https://morigaon.dcourts.gov.in/, and the viva-voce date, time and venue only on the official website.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for Para Legal Volunteer in Morigaon?
faq.answer: Residents of Morigaon District, including teachers, retired government servants (ex-servicemen), senior citizens, MSW students, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students and law students, NGO and SHG members, tea tribe community members and others listed in the notice.
